title: aibus workflow v1
description: A workflow file (.aibus/workflows/<name>.toml, or workflows/<name>.toml inside a .aibus bundle) read as JSON: a named chain of delegations, or with [[route]] a graph of them. Every field added for the compiler (#283) is optional, and a file that uses none of them is the chain it always was. This schema covers the shape only. It cannot express the template rules (a {{...}} must close, be one of input, prev.summary or steps.<key>.summary, and read a step that runs before this one), the graph rules (routes name steps, forward routes make a DAG from the first step that reaches every scheduled step, a route back needs max_iterations, a native subagent has a parent on its own runtime and is never routed to), or which agents exist and what their tools grant. `aibus workflow validate` and `aibus workflow plan --dry-run` check all of them.

schema_version.description: Optional. "1" is this format; a file without it is read the same way.

name.description: The workflow's name; the file name is used when this is left out.

revision.description: The author's label for this version of the file, shown in a plan.

agent.description: The agent that runs this step.

prompt.description: What the agent is asked. May use {{input}}, {{prev.summary}} and {{steps.<agent>.summary}}.

gate.description: A shell command run after the step with hook semantics; exit 2 stops the chain.

on_fail.description: When this step fails, the step before it and this one run again, at most N times.

id.description: A name for the step when its agent is not enough; the step's key. Unique, and not another step's agent.

runtime.description: Where the step runs: aibus (this binary, the default) or cli.claude (the official Claude Code CLI, experimental: it plans and does not run yet).

mode.description: aibus_managed (the default), native (a subagent inside its parent's vendor process) or native_or_managed (the routing policy picks).

parent.description: The key of the step that launches this one; it comes earlier in the file.

requires.description: Capabilities the step's agent must have tools for.

isolation.description: git_worktree runs the step in its own worktree (aibus-managed steps only).

output.description: summary (the default) or json, which a route can check with <step>.artifact_valid.

route.description: Explicit edges. With any route the file order is no longer the run order: the first step starts, and control follows the routes.

when.description: <step>.completed, <step>.failed or <step>.artifact_valid joined with !, && and ||; the default is <from>.completed.

max_iterations.description: Makes the route a loop back to an earlier step, taken at most this often in a run.

limits.description: The envelope a scheduler holds the whole workflow to.

approvals.description: What needs a person's yes before it happens.
